primitives.name: Ball Trajectory Field Interaction
primitives.verbatim_quote: 278 WALTER CAMP'S BOOK OF COLLEGE SPORTS A home-run now would tie the score, and the Brown man at the bat evidently realized this, for he made a long drive into center field.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'v_0': 'initial velocity of the ball (m/s)', 'θ': 'launch angle (radians)', 'x(t)': 'horizontal position of the ball (m)', 'y(t)': 'vertical position of the ball (m)'}
primitives.assumptions: Negligible air resistance, constant gravitational acceleration, uniform field surface.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When ball strikes non-field surface (e.g., church wall).

layer2.mapping: Spatial kinematics of ball path intersecting field boundaries and defensive coverage zones.
layer2.telemetry: Ball's x,y coordinates at impact with boundary.

primitives.name: Defensive Fielder Reaction Time
primitives.verbatim_quote: The Brown crowd yelled madly with delight; but the ball struck the church and bounded back to the fielder, who turned instantly and fielded it home, putting out the man who was running in from second by the veriest scratch I ever saw on the ball-field.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'t_r': 'reaction time of fielder (s)', 'd_f': 'distance from fielder to ball (m)', 'v_f': "fielder's speed (m/s)"}
primitives.assumptions: Instantaneous reaction, linear motion, perfect fielder coordination.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When reaction time exceeds optimal threshold for interception.

layer2.mapping: Temporal optimization of fielder movement to intercept rebound trajectory.
layer2.telemetry: Time from ball bounce to fielder contact.

primitives.name: Run Scoring Event Probability
primitives.verbatim_quote: Harvard came to the bat for the ninth inning, and their first batter went out by a throw from short-stop to first base; a second batsman followed with a basehit; a third went to first base on an error, which gave the runner second.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'P_s': 'probability of scoring run (dimensionless)', 'B_i': "batter i's outcome (0 or 1)", 'R_b': 'runs scored in inning (unitless)'}
primitives.assumptions: Independent batting outcomes, fixed base-running success rate.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When base runners advance beyond scoring position.

layer2.mapping: Binomial process modeling cumulative run generation per inning.
layer2.telemetry: Cumulative runs per inning and base advancement frequency.
